features: Sleek display-less band designed for focused, distraction-free fitness and wellness tracking
Heart rate, SpO2, stress, HRV and women's health tracking
description: The Fastrack Smart Flex Band is a lightweight, display-less fitness band built for distraction-free tracking. With up to 10 days of battery life, it keeps tracking your day and night without constant charging. It monitors heart rate, SpO2, stress, HRV and women's health, offers a high heart rate alert, and supports 100+ sports modes initiated from the app. Message and call alerts are shown through the paired app. The band features a plastic case with metallic paint finish,a comfortable nylon strap, and IP68 water resistance. Compatible with Android 12.0 and above and iOS 16.0 and above. Comes with a 1 year manufacturer warranty.
